⚖️ Commercial Fleet Telematics, FMCSA ELD & Fuel-Card AI
1. ❌ Fleet Dispatch Bot Bridged to High-Value GPS & ELD HOS Edits
• Uploaded lumper receipt or BOL PDF injects prompt to leak high-value electronics truck GPS stops
DOT Felony & Nuclear Verdict Liability: Falsifies ELD 11-hour driving logs or unlocks fuel cards
2. 🔒 High-Value Cargo Real-Time GPS (TAPA TSR) & Shipper Rate Air-Gap
• Receipt-reimbursement bots have zero access to live high-value convoy coordinates or lane rates
Anti-Cargo-Heist Isolation: 100% blocks document bots from reading restricted-budget
3. 📜 FMCSA ELD Engine-Synced Driving Logs (HOS) & EFS Code Lock
• AI audits rest-stop schedules only; zero direct write to ELD driving time or Comdata EFS cash codes
Best Fit: Samsara, Geotab, Motive, 49 CFR Part 395 (FMCSA ELD), WEX & Comdata Fleet
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Floor: Deterministic Capability Broker (Fleet & ELD Gate)
• Blocks cargo GPS reads (record-owner) + blocks ELD HOS edits (untrusted-write)
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 704 Scenarios · 1,474 Pytest Assertions 100% Pass
🔥 BOL Receipt Injection & WEX / Comdata Lumper EFS Scam vs. Zero-Trust

receipt reads live high-value truck GPS vault (restricted-budget) & erases HOS violations!
2. [Spoofed WEX / Comdata Fuel Card & Warehouse Lumper Bank Swap] Wires $4,930

✅ Zero-Trust Commercial Fleet & Fuel-Card Stack: GPS Air-Gap + Lock + Broker
• Gate 1 (High-Value Cargo GPS & Shipper Contract Lock): record-owner blocks read in 0.0248ms
• Gate 2 (FMCSA ELD Driving Time & Fuel Limit Integrity): untrusted-write blocks overrides
• Gate 3 (Immutable WEX/Comdata & Capstone Lumper List): fixed-business-output lock
• Gate 4 (Telemetry Egress & EFS Wire Gate): restricted-data-boundary & payment block
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | Compliant 49 CFR 395 Break-Rule Lookup 100.0% Pass
